Thanks — if you can send the W9 and bank letter this morning we'll aim to finish setup today.

Subject: RE: Next steps to finish vendor account (coupa/portal link issue)

Susan — thanks for sending those. I reviewed the screenshot: the portal is expecting the "Legal Entity / Registered Name" field (Coupa label) to match the Tax ID record. Your W-9 shows "Aurora Supply, Inc." but the portal has "Aurora Supply" (no Inc.) which triggers the mismatch and blocks SSO completion. Two ways to proceed (pick one):

A) Vendor updates Coupa profile: in the supplier portal, under Company Details -> Legal Name, add the exact string from the W-9 (Aurora Supply, Inc.). Then the SSO link will finish and the account will move to Active. After that, we can set remit-to and issue POs.

B) We complete manual verification: we upload your W-9 and bank letter to your Coupa record, change registry status to "Manual verify - legal" and override the portal mismatch. This requires Procurement/Payments to do a short verification step (paper trail) and will take ~1 business day.

If you confirm option B, I'll raise the MH ticket for Dylan to run the manual verify and lock in a PO test window. If option A, reply when you've corrected the portal string and we'll watch the status.

Action items for Aurora to close today if possible:
- Confirm which option (A or B) you prefer
- Provide invoice contact details (Name, email, phone)
- Confirm remit instructions (ACH or check)

Thanks again — aim is to have POs flowing by Monday if we get this wrapped up.

Best,
Priya
